issue.standard_remedy: Harmonize prices to the best plant / global agreement
issue.summary: Pays 18.8% on average above the best plant for the same materials

plan.diagnosis: Gothenburg plant (Nordic Motion AB on Dynamics 365 F&O) is paying 18.8% premium versus best-plant pricing across 237 materials, resulting in USD 3,787,957 annual excess spend. Root cause is lack of procurement harmonization and failure to leverage global/regional contracts, allowing plant-level purchasing autonomy without price governance.

remedy_steps.step: Conduct immediate price benchmarking to identify the best plant prices for all 237 materials and quantify item-level variances against Gothenburg current pricing
Negotiate with incumbent suppliers to match best-plant pricing or issue RFQ to alternate suppliers qualified at other plants; target 18.8% price reduction across the 237-material basket
Update Dynamics 365 F&O purchase agreements and trade agreements to reflect harmonized pricing; configure workflow approvals to block PO creation above best-plant benchmarks
Implement mandatory source-list enforcement in Dynamics 365 for the 237 materials, restricting Gothenburg buyers to approved suppliers with harmonized pricing
Deploy monthly price variance dashboard comparing Gothenburg actual spend vs. best-plant benchmarks and escalate deviations >5% to plant controller and regional CPO

plan.expected_impact: Capture USD 3,787,957 in annual savings by harmonizing Gothenburg pricing to best-plant levels across 237 materials
kpis: Average price premium vs. best plant (target: 0% from current 18.8%)
Realized savings from harmonization (target: USD 3,787,957 annualized)
Percentage of 237 materials on approved source list with harmonized pricing (target: 100%)
Number of POs exceeding best-plant benchmark blocked by system controls (monitor weekly)
risks: Supplier resistance to 18.8% price reduction may disrupt supply continuity for Gothenburg plant
Best-plant pricing may reflect different payment terms, volumes, or service levels not applicable to Gothenburg
Dynamics 365 configuration delays or insufficient buyer training may undermine enforcement of new controls
Multi-ERP environment (SAP, Oracle EBS, NetSuite, Coupa) may have conflicting master data for same materials, complicating cross-plant benchmarking
erp_actions: Dynamics 365 F&O: Create or update purchase agreements (table PurchAgreementHeader) for 237 materials with harmonized best-plant pricing effective immediately
Dynamics 365 F&O: Configure trade agreements (PriceDiscTable) to enforce ceiling prices equal to best-plant benchmarks; set price tolerance to 0%
Dynamics 365 F&O: Enable source list (table InventBuyerGroup) for Gothenburg plant (site/warehouse) restricting the 237 materials to approved vendors only
Dynamics 365 F&O: Implement purchase order approval workflow (BuyingPolicy) to require director sign-off for any PO line exceeding best-plant price by >2%

Dynamics 365 F&O: Add custom field to vendor master (VendTable extension) flagging suppliers with harmonized pricing agreements; create Power BI report linking PurchLine actuals to trade agreement benchmarks for monthly variance tracking
